scripts.build:android: expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Laundry.xcworkspace -scheme Laundry -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
